settings.lede: Every ComfortCrest bed is cut, sprung, upholstered and finished by the same small team, in the same workshop, for one order at a time.

settings.title: The frame
settings.text: Kiln-dried hardwood, corner-blocked and screwed rather than stapled. It is the part nobody sees, and the reason the bed does not creak in year three.

settings.title: The base
settings.text: Sprung slats on flexible beech, not a flat board. They take the load off the mattress and add years to it.

settings.title: The upholstery
settings.text: High-density foam over the frame, then fabric cut, pinned and hand-finished on the piece itself. Every seam is pulled true by hand.

settings.title: The finish
settings.text: Legs turned and stained to match, fixings bagged and labelled, and the whole bed checked over by the person who made it before it is wrapped.

settings.heading: Two weeks of work, and a bed that outlasts the room
settings.body: Nothing here is flat-packed in a factory and shipped from a warehouse. That is why we can guarantee the frame for ten years — and why we are happy to tell you exactly what is inside it.

settings.title: Handmade in Britain
settings.note: Built to order in our own workshop

settings.title: 10-year guarantee
settings.note: On the frame of every bed we make
